# XYZ Lab

> XYZ Lab is a digital marketing tutorial site offering step-by-step video guides, benchmarks, prompt libraries, report templates, and courses on paid advertising, analytics, AI tools, SEO, eCommerce, web builders, and social media platforms.

## Courses

- [AI for Google Ads](https://xyzlab.com/google-ads-course/): Master Google Ads with AI — campaign setup, Smart Bidding, keyword research, and ROAS optimisation.
- [AI for Meta Ads](https://xyzlab.com/meta-ads-course/): Complete Meta Ads training covering Facebook and Instagram advertising.
- [AI for SEO](https://xyzlab.com/seo-aio-course/): All-in-one SEO course covering on-page, technical, and off-page optimisation.
- [AI for Marketing Analytics](https://xyzlab.com/ai-marketing-analytics-course/): Use AI to analyse and report on marketing performance.
- [AI Content Creation](https://xyzlab.com/ai-content-creation-course/): Create marketing content faster using AI tools.
- [Vibe Coding with AI](https://xyzlab.com/vibe-coding-course/): Build web projects using AI-assisted coding.
- [Data Studio Full Course](https://xyzlab.com/data-studio/course/): Complete Looker Studio / Data Studio course for marketers.
